findings.text: The retrieved evidence supports RoadAccidents hypotheses, not Assault hypotheses, between 30 and 35 seconds. The surveillance-event model produced RoadAccidents hypotheses in windows overlapping that range with 2-9 persons detected.

The surveillance-event model produced an Assault hypothesis; the available evidence does not establish that an assault occurred.

The available evidence is consistent with persons being detected at the same time as model hypotheses. The retrieved evidence supports temporal overlap only and does not indicate the detected persons were involved in the hypothesized events.

The retrieved evidence supports object reports of backpack, skateboard, motorcycle and suitcase during RoadAccidents-hypothesis windows, and persons with cars in later RoadAccidents-hypothesis windows. Object detections overlap temporally with hypotheses only.
